title: ranunculus geraniifolius subsp. gouanii
intro: Ranunculus geraniifolius subsp. gouanii, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. This perennial herb has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues. Alpine Buttercup is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions, which may aid in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Buttercup include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
